name: Cadence 0.4.0
body:
## Cadence 0.4.0

_Released 2026-11-23 · minor release_

> [!NOTE]
> Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

## What's Changed

### 🖥️ Mac app
#### ✨ New features
* Show the working day on the Mac, with an end-of-day sum-up by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/65
* A setup assistant on first launch by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/74
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Mascot in the menu's day card reads properly in light mode by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/72
* Long countdowns fit inside the full-screen alert's ring by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/73

### 📱 iPhone app
#### ✨ New features
* Let apps Cadence paused, like YouTube Music, pick up again by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/66
* Drop joined meetings from the iPhone Live Activity; count missed ones up in red by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/68
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Open Spotify directly when its installed check says no by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/67
* Long countdowns fit inside the full-screen alert's ring by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/73

### ⚙️ Build and release
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Build CI and releases on the Xcode 27 runner by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/71

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

## 📥 Install

1. Download **Cadence-0.4.0.dmg** below.
2. Open it and drag **Cadence** into **Applications**.
3. Launch Cadence from Applications and allow calendar access when asked.

Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon.

<details>
<summary>Downloads and checksums</summary>

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Cadence-0.4.0.dmg` | Disk image, drag to Applications |
| `Cadence-0.4.0.zip` | The same app, zipped (for scripted installs) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for both |

```text
1a287d979387380652524eac8900d57635adb1c93470668b0a44db61ff9d3b69  Cadence-0.4.0.dmg
a848c41679598b4d49a80bbff3615d0524882bf8e476371df226924bfd800676  Cadence-0.4.0.zip
```

</details>

name: Cadence 0.1.0
body:
## Cadence 0.1.0

_Released 2026-11-22 · first release_

> [!NOTE]
> Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

## What's Changed

### 🖥️ Mac app
#### ✨ New features
* Add Cadence for iPhone: desk companion, Dynamic Island and Mac pairing by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/1
* Give the DMG a styled drag-to-Applications window by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/4
* iPhone handles new invites and double-bookings, with a googly-eyed Dynamic Island by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/5
* Agenda-only calendars: keep a calendar in the agenda without alerts or clashes by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/7
* Colour labels, instant save feedback, and links that open in front by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/8
* Media controls on the desk display, shared with the Mac, with a meeting hand-off by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/11
* Assistants can attach notes, links, checklists and bingo cards to meetings by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/23
* iPhone remembers your Mac on every network, and the Mac shows each iPhone's model or chosen name by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/24
* Working hours, defended breaks and day moments with the mascot by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/28
* Pair the iPhone with several Macs (and the Mac with several iPhones) by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/33
* Export and import settings as a .cadconf file by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/35
* About screen on Mac and iPhone, with a pokeable googly-eyed mascot by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/36
* A key per iPhone, single-use pairing codes, and safer meeting links by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/38
* Set up Gemini CLI and Antigravity from Settings → Assistants by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/40
* Link analytics behind Advanced on paired device pages by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/41
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Clash prompts no longer ask again every time Cadence starts by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/9
* Show the date a recurring invite next happens by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/10
* Group repeated assistants in the Assistants status line by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/12
* Fix Spotify connecting from the desk button, and stop the Mac holding AirPods by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/13
* Spotify track on connect, Mac media keys remote-control the iPhone by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/14
* Fix media remote control giving up on the phone after 12 seconds by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/15
* Fix running-late card never appearing on the full-screen alert by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/17
* Let the menu bar item be narrower so macOS hides it less by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/20
* Option to offer only named Google colours by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/26
* Fix Settings toolbar overflow and tidy the Work tab by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/30
* Tidy the time fields in Settings → Work by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/32
* Tidier Settings window on the Mac by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/34
* Bundle the Slack app into release builds by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/44
#### 📦 Other changes
* Make the OAuth landing page prettier by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/2
* Show paired phones as "Name (Model)"; device-name entitlement switch by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/37

### 📱 iPhone app
#### ✨ New features
* Add Cadence for iPhone: desk companion, Dynamic Island and Mac pairing by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/1
* iPhone handles new invites and double-bookings, with a googly-eyed Dynamic Island by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/5
* iPhone keeps the Mac's agenda offline, lets you nickname the Mac, and tints the Island icon by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/6
* Agenda-only calendars: keep a calendar in the agenda without alerts or clashes by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/7
* Media controls on the desk display, shared with the Mac, with a meeting hand-off by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/11
* iPhone widgets: time to your next meeting on the Home Screen and Lock Screen by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/19
* iPhone widgets show your first meeting tomorrow in the evening by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/21
* Desk mode: tea-break mascot when the day's done; keep Join on screen by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/22
* Assistants can attach notes, links, checklists and bingo cards to meetings by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/23
* iPhone remembers your Mac on every network, and the Mac shows each iPhone's model or chosen name by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/24
* Working hours, defended breaks and day moments with the mascot by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/28
* Spotify on iPhone: bring your own client ID by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/31
* Pair the iPhone with several Macs (and the Mac with several iPhones) by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/33
* About screen on Mac and iPhone, with a pokeable googly-eyed mascot by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/36
* A key per iPhone, single-use pairing codes, and safer meeting links by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/38
* Link analytics behind Advanced on paired device pages by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/41
* Get the iPhone app ready for the App Store, with a volume pill on the desk by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/42
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Show the date a recurring invite next happens by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/10
* Fix Spotify connecting from the desk button, and stop the Mac holding AirPods by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/13
* Spotify track on connect, Mac media keys remote-control the iPhone by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/14
* Fix media remote control giving up on the phone after 12 seconds by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/15
* Renew Spotify access quietly instead of asking every hour by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/16
* Tidy the iPhone Settings into grouped pages by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/39
#### 📦 Other changes
* Show paired phones as "Name (Model)"; device-name entitlement switch by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/37
* Give the iPhone app a proper first launch by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/43

### ⚙️ Build and release
#### ✨ New features
* Add Cadence for iPhone: desk companion, Dynamic Island and Mac pairing by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/1
* Add CI, release pipeline, and PR/issue templates by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/3
* Get the iPhone app ready for the App Store, with a volume pill on the desk by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/42
#### 🐛 Fixes and improvements
* Copy local build config into new Claude Code worktrees by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/18
* Bundle the Slack app into release builds by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/44
* Skip the iPhone release job until it's set up by @lilmuckers in https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/pull/45

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lilmuckers/calendar-cadence/commits/v0.1.0

## 📥 Install
